en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 324 - A group of our scholars narrated to me from Harun Ibn Musa from Muhammad Ibn Himam, saying:

Abdullah Ibn Ja’far Himyari said: When Abu Amr passed away, letters continued to arrive with the same handwriting through which we used to receive on the virtue of Abu Ja’far taking his father’s place.
